heading: Vigil mechanism

chapter.title: CORPORATE GOVERNANCE NORMS FOR A LISTED ENTITY WHICH HAS LISTED ITS NON-CONVERTIBLE DEBT SECURITIES

content:
62J. (1) The HVDLE shall formulate a vigil mechanism/ whistle blower policy for
directors and employees to report genuine concerns.
(2) The vigil mechanism shall provide for adequate safeguards against victimization
of director(s) or employee(s) or any other person who avail the mechanism and also
provide for direct access to the chairperson of the audit committee in appropriate or
exceptional cases.
